name: Crossroads Cat

primary.name: Claw Swipe
primary.description: Sweep three claws across a close 65-degree arc: 22 damage, 86 reach. Each enemy is hit once.

secondary.name: Whirlwind Spin
secondary.description: Sweep your claws around yourself over 0.6s. Each enemy within 128 reach takes 43 damage once when the moving sweep reaches it. Walls block the swipe.

special.name: Shadowstep
special.description: Become invisible to enemy players for 3 seconds, heal 30 HP and move 45% faster. You and allies see a faint silhouette. Attacking ends stealth; area attacks can still hit you.

passive: Quick Paws: primary attack cooldown reduced by 20%.

technique.name: Broad Whirl
technique.description: Sweep 30% farther around you for 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Nine-Lives Mirage
final_technique.description: Replace stealth and healing with three delayed crescent bursts, 18 damage each and a brief stun. No invisibility or self-heal.

attack.name: Nine-Lives Mirage
attack.description: Replace stealth and healing with three delayed crescent bursts, 18 damage each and a brief stun. No invisibility or self-heal.
